QuestInfo.name: [Mushroom Shrine Tales] The Land of the Dead
QuestInfo.0: #p9112001# tells you that she received another vision from Daidarabotchi. Go to #m800000000# and see what she has to say.
QuestInfo.1: According to Kino Konoko's vision, a new god born in the western lands of Zipangu has the Water Element. Enter the Land of the Dead in western Zipangu and track down the Water Element.
